name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – After § 41 – Am 1
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 41a. Calls on the Commission, to submit, on the basis of Article 175 third paragraph of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, a proposal, within three months, to amend Regulation (EU) 2021/241 to incorporate an extension to the period for implementing the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF) until 31 August 2028;
